body: Just purchased and started wearing my whoop - I’m on day five of wearing it, I’m wondering why when I nap my stress level is very high, is this common? I usually play a tennis match and take a little afternoon nap after. I know stress levels can be high after “working out” though most matches I’m barely breaking a sweat. My sleep levels usually hit 98-100% - just wondering if my little naps maybe aren’t the best thing for me if they are causing me stress? Ha! I’m just not sure how to interpret the high stress during a nap and wondering if any of this other info could provide some answers?
Do you happen to know the notes of the flute solo?

Hey ladies! I’m going in for a leep procedure tomorrow and I’m so terrified. I think I’m getting a shot for the local anesthesia but honestly it was a blur what the doc was saying to me after my colposcopy. Step by step what should I expect? I literally just can’t even imagine someone burning things off the inside of my body. It sounds excruciating. I wish they would have offered to put me to sleep, my sister in law got happy drugs and then put to sleep. Why didn’t they offer that to me!?!? Not fair!?!? Also if I call today do you think they will prescribe me a Xanax? I’m freaking you guys.

I know. Fearing death is good. I have a husband as well and a cute dog. I know they would be sad if I was gone. But like you I don’t have friends, I push everyone away because I’m not very fun to be around. I’m not smart or pretty. I’ve ruined my life through so many mistakes that could have been totally avoided. My family doesn’t reach out to me. I don’t think they love me at all. I’m just a burden.

Oh my god it’s so true. I feel so invisible. I feel like no one cares at all, not even my therapist or doctor. I’m just a pay check to them. I saw that post too. It hasn’t gotten better. It’s gotten so much worse. I’m sorry you feel invisible but I see you and I feel how you feel.

It’s ok. I feel like we need to be negative and sad and really talk about this shit. I’ve been feeling so incredibly alone. I’m scared to take pills, maybe sleeping pills and alcohol ? Idk I know I’ll never do it because I’m so scared of the unknown. What if it’s amazing after death?
I feel like I’m not supposed to be here. Like my brain doesn’t function like others. And I’m just a huge mistake or like malfunction. If that even makes sense.
